question: What fire-related and concluding rites are treated in chapter eleven?
premises: Worship of the weapon mantra and the fire rite are treated.
Consecration related to fire and oblations of satisfaction are treated.
Preparation of the rice offering and rites ending with the tooth-stick are treated.
inference: Chapter 11 details a full sequence of fire rites and concluding initiatory observances.
